name: Bullseye Lantern
summary: Burns Oil: Bright Light in a 60-ft Cone, Dim Light 60 ft beyond; 6 hours per flask.
text: A Bullseye Lantern burns Oil to shed Bright Light in a 60-foot Cone and Dim Light for another 60 feet beyond that. One flask of Oil keeps it lit for 6 hours in total. Its light is a Cone, not a radius.
